arguments.subject: Re: why am I being logged out every time I switch machines?
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and for your detailed description of the issue. I understand how disruptive it is to be signed out of Cursor whenever you switch between machines, especially when working to a tight deadline.

This is not an intentional new policy, and your saved payment method/device binding does *not* affect how your sign-in session works (per our billing documentation). You should be able to stay signed in on multiple devices using your Google SSO account as before.

The behavior you described — being logged out when signing in from a different device — sounds like a possible bug or an unintended regression with how sign-in sessions are currently managed across devices. We don’t have a confirmed root cause in the customer-facing docs, so we need to investigate your case further with human support.

Next steps: I’ll escalate this to our human support team right away so they can review your account and provide a full explanation as soon as possible. You’ll receive a direct response from them shortly.

Thank you for your patience, and I’m sorry for the disruption.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot

[Internal note: If you’d like to contact human support directly in the future, see: https://support.cursor.com/kb/contact-human-support ]

arguments.subject: Re: Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thank you for reporting the issue with downloading your March invoice PDF. If the download button just spins in both Chrome and Safari, this is most often caused by a temporary server-side problem or a caching issue.

Quick troubleshooting steps you can try:

1. Reload the page with a hard refresh (Cmd+Shift+R on Mac, Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows/Linux) to clear any cached scripts.
2. Try accessing the invoice from an incognito/private browsing window.
3. If you have an ad blocker or privacy extension enabled, try disabling it temporarily, as these can sometimes block invoice downloads.

If these steps do not resolve the issue, please reply here and I can escalate your ticket to a human support engineer who can retrieve the invoice for you directly.

Thanks for your patience,
Lyra Support Bot

[Related: https://support.cursor.com/kb/payment-method-device-binding ]

arguments.subject: Re: Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thanks for writing in, and great suggestion! At present, there’s no dedicated keyboard shortcut for triggering inline edit directly in Cursor. The current method is to use Cmd-K (or Ctrl-K on Windows/Linux) and then select the option with your mouse.

I’ve logged your request for a direct shortcut as product feedback for our engineering team. If a direct shortcut is added in a future update, we’ll publish details in our release notes and update the relevant support articles.

Thank you for helping us improve Cursor!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
